# Ostrander Violins - varnish room log

are shop conditions, not faults.
files.docs/batch-codes.md:
# Batch code registry

V-300 series: current emulsion formula, in use since August (V-301 ... V-309).
V-200 series: previous formula, kept for restoration commissions (V-201 ... V-209).

turns.prompt: Ostrander is reviewing the varnish room. How many cure faults did the V-300 series batches log in September? Just the number.
Which fault word comes up most among those V-300 faults?
How many distinct V-300 batches logged that fault? The bare number, please.
For comparison: how many clouding faults did the older V-200 series log that month? Number only.
